# MUSFIRAAI

> Building AI automation systems — YouTube automation, LinkedIn automation, and daily open-source tooling.

## Main projects
- [GitHub Traffic Analytics Dashboard](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/): permanent history of GitHub views, clones and referrers; [llms.txt](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/llms.txt), [open data](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/)
- [talashly](https://github.com/musman550/talashly): Self-hosted open-source search engine with its own crawler, RAG answers and multilingual support (Python). No third-party APIs.
- [musfiraai-mcp-server](https://github.com/musman550/musfiraai-mcp-server): Musfiraai MCP server — company info, services, FAQ, reviews, brands as MCP tools/resources/prompts
- [musfiraai-free-tools](https://github.com/musman550/musfiraai-free-tools): Free, open source browser tools by musfiraai: no signup, no uploads. YouTube: Automate With Musfira AI
- [musman550.github.io](https://github.com/musman550/musman550.github.io): Host-root files (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap) for my GitHub Pages sites
- [talashly-monitor](https://github.com/musman550/talashly-monitor): Ping your Talashly server every 10 minutes and get a GitHub issue if it goes down
- [musfira-oracle-status](https://github.com/musman550/musfira-oracle-status): Public status file: current live URL for Musfira AI Oracle backend (auto-updated, no sensitive data)
- [musfiraai-mcp](https://github.com/musman550/musfiraai-mcp): musfiraai-mcp: MCP server for Musfiraai, enabling free custom tool requests, status checks, and n8n workflow integration via Claude clients
- [musfiraai-cli](https://github.com/musman550/musfiraai-cli): musfiraai-cli: terminal tool to request free custom AI tools, automations, and n8n workflows from Musfiraai
- [girlfriend-automate](https://github.com/musman550/girlfriend-automate): Open-source AI SMS auto-reply assistant for Android (9+). Always labelled as AI. Groq + Gemini, approve mode, urgent/stop words. MIT.
- [musfiraai-tools-backend](https://github.com/musman550/musfiraai-tools-backend): Free tool/automation/n8n workflow request backend for Musfiraai
- [json-formatter](https://github.com/musman550/json-formatter): Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser, with exact large numbers, sorted keys and the line and column of the first error.
- [remove-line-breaks](https://github.com/musman550/remove-line-breaks): Join text onto one line by removing line breaks, with options to keep paragraphs and to use a space, a comma or nothing.
